rules.sentence: A clinical short tooth can be due to gingivitis, gingival hyperplasia, altered passive eruption, or tooth wear, and examining the periodontal tissues helps identify the etiology.

The treatment modalities vary according to the etiology of the gummy smile - the key is accurately recognizing the cause of the pathology.
In some cases, the gummy smile results from more than 1 factor, eg, vertical maxillary excess and hypermobile lip, and a combination of techniques can be implemented.

Less invasive treatment options include botulin toxin injection and a newer alternative: hyaluronic acid injection; the surgical management ranges from gingivectomy, modified lip repositioning, and orthognathic surgery, which is reserved for severe VME as it carries high rates of morbidity and requires hospitalization.
Finally, orthodontic treatment by itself may be sufficient to resolve some cases of a gummy smile.
